title: Sign in to Spotify
instructions: Sign in to Spotify in the browser. Your session is stored privately by MetroFuse and is used for your Spotify metadata and library.
error: Spotify could not verify this session. Sign in again or retry.
sessionHint: Paste a Spotify cookie header containing sp_dc. Including sp_t enables Spotify personalization.
browserOpened: Complete Spotify sign-in in the browser window.
browserUnavailable: The browser could not complete sign-in. Retry or use your session cookie.
